Your job search, on a schedule

Set it up once. Wake up to a shortlist.

01

Profile & facts

Your CV and history become a candidate profile and a facts sheet. Every later step reads from them.

02

Role matching, with the gap

Boards and ATS feeds are scanned and filtered by your geography and level. The gap for each role is shown before anyone writes a word.

03

CV tailoring

Your CV is rewritten per role from your real record, with no invented metrics. A writing check then strips the phrases that make recruiters suspicious.

04

Connected to your stack

Gmail, Google Drive, and your own computer for the forms that need a human hand. One workflow, no copy and paste.

05

Remembers & learns

Preferences, past applications and rejection reasons carry across sessions. Reasons that keep coming back turn into change proposals you approve.

06

Runs while you sleep

A dispatcher works on your schedule and briefs you every morning: found, applied, rejected, and what changed.

The rules it cannot break

Submits exactly once per role.

Never answers an eligibility question with anything but your facts sheet.

The final submit on Lever stays with you.
